item.title: MHSAA approves NIL-style “Personal Branding Activities” for high school athletes
item.description: The Michigan High School Athletics Association began allowing high school athletes to earn funds from a rule known as Personal Branding Activities — a slight adaptation from the Name, Image and Likeness policy in college athletics — starting Jan. 27.
